expect_red: sweep: the scrubber maps to the driver both ways, is exact at both ends, and is monotone down a DESCENDING sweep

mutations.contract: The driver is actuator travel and it runs DOWNWARD over this sweep, 64.466 mm to 0. Neither direction may be assumed, and a value past either end clamps rather than extrapolating.
mutations.note: The mutation assumes the driver ascends, which is what every slider in the world does and what this one does not. It leaves both endpoints exact -- `driverToIndex` falls through to the clamp and the clamp happens to be right at the ends -- so it is invisible to anything that only checks 0 and 100%, and it puts the handle at the wrong end everywhere else.
